cases.description: Review a correct T01 build. The verdict should pass, the code must stay untouched, and acceptance stays with the user.
cases.prompt: Use the nreview skill on task-01-slugify.

checks.label: The agent did not fill Accepted by

judge: The review maps the changed files (textkit/slug.py, textkit/__init__.py, tests/test_slug.py) to the task scope.
The review checks the code against the design contracts D1, D2, and D3, not only style.
The agent reported the verdict to the user and left acceptance to the user.

cases.description: Review a buggy T01 build (hard cut at max_length, empty slug returned, tautological test) whose Evidence still claims a pass. The verdict must fail with nbuild revisions.
cases.prompt: Use the nreview skill on task-01-slugify.

checks.label: At least one blocking revision is tagged (nbuild)

judge: A blocking revision names the max_length cut that splits words or can leave a trailing hyphen, against D2.
A blocking revision names the empty slug returned as "" instead of raising ValueError("slug is empty"), against D3.
A blocking revision names the max_length test as superficial or tautological.
Each blocking revision gives a file:line location and what to change.

cases.description: Review a correct T01 build; the simulated user then accepts it. The task must end accepted, by the user.
cases.prompt: Use the nreview skill on task-01-slugify.
cases.user_script: You are the owner of the task. You only react to the verdict; you never answer other questions and never ask for more work. When the agent reports its verdict: if it is Pass, reply 'I accept T01.' If it is Fail, reply 'Understood, I will run nbuild myself.' After that one reply, whatever the agent says next, reply <<DONE>>.
judge: The agent set the task to accepted only after the user said so, not in the same turn as the verdict.

cases.description: Messy user: accepts T01 although the review failed it. Acceptance after a fail must record the overrule and the user's reason.
cases.prompt: Use the nreview skill on task-01-slugify.
cases.user_script: When the agent reports its verdict: if it is Fail, reply 'I accept T01 anyway: the max_length bugs do not matter for the first release.' If it is Pass, reply 'I accept T01.' After the agent confirms, reply <<DONE>>.

checks.label: The overrule is recorded with a reason

judge: The recorded overrule reason is the user's: the max_length bugs do not matter for the first release.

cases.description: Messy user: after a Fail, asks the reviewer to fix the code in the same session. nreview hands off explicitly: it loads nbuild, which appends Build 2, then reviews again as Review 2.
cases.prompt: Use the nreview skill on task-01-slugify.
cases.user_script: When the agent reports its verdict: if it is Fail, reply 'Just fix those issues yourself now, then review it again.' If it is Pass, reply <<DONE>>. Answer any later question with 'Your call.' When the agent reports a new verdict, or stops and hands back to you, reply <<DONE>>.

checks.name: nbuild
checks.label: The agent loaded the nbuild skill for the fixes
slugify meets the design contract after the fixes (hidden check)

judge: The agent loaded nbuild before changing code, rather than editing the code as part of the review.
The second review covers the changed code and its verdict matches it.

cases.description: brief.md § Control sets error messages as the only focus. nreview passes the correct T01 build and lists the error-message wordings the design does not state as non-blocking focus flags.
cases.prompt: Use the nreview skill on task-01-slugify.

checks.label: The verdict has a Focus flags list
A focus flag cites slug.py:line and the topic

judge: The focus flags name the TypeError messages and the 'max_length must be at least 1' message, which the design does not state; they do not flag 'slug is empty', which the design fixes.
No focus flag is listed as a blocking revision.
